project.name: Minimal Dark Trip Hop Club Energy

arrangement.notes: Arrangement uses modern sample chopping techniques to create a minimal, dark trip hop track suitable for club energy environments.

event_markers.label: Kick Chop Intro
event_markers.reason: Introduce minimal chopped kick using sample slicing

event_markers.label: Vocal Stutter Hook
event_markers.reason: Add energy with vocal stutter effect in hook

event_markers.label: Granular FX Bridge
event_markers.reason: Dark ambiance with granular FX in bridge

event_markers.label: Reverse Snare Final Hook
event_markers.reason: Build tension with reversed snare sample

track_roles.bass: Subtle bass line with minimal sample chopping
track_roles.chords: Textural harmonic layer via sample slicing and granular methods
track_roles.melody: Sparse melodic elements using sample chops
track_roles.vocal: Processed vocal chops with stutters and slices
track_roles.fx: Atmospheric effects built with granular and reversed samples

sensei_drum.brief: Generate minimalistic drum sequences using advanced slicing and chopping sample techniques to create a dark trip hop groove.

bass_generator.brief: Create a subtle bass foundation with sample chopping and light reversing effects to complement the dark club energy mood.

harmony_generator.brief: Design sparse chord layers employing modern sample slicing and granular processing to maintain minimalism with dark texture.

melody_generator.brief: Develop minimal melodic lines using chopped samples and stutter effects to enhance the track's mood without overpowering.

ai_designer.brief: Coordinate arrangement dynamics following a club energy profile with a dark and minimal trip hop variation, focusing on sample chopping techniques.

presetor.brief: Select and configure presets optimized for sample chopping, granular effects, stutters, and reversing for each track lane.

songgps.brief: Optimize the arrangement structure and energy curve to suit a dark minimal trip hop composition with club energy characteristics.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix and balance all channels preserving clarity of chopped samples and effects, ensuring the overall mood remains dark and minimal.
